blocks.text: The Supreme Court has acquitted of cyberlibel an individual who posted on social media the alleged extortion attempt of a town mayor in Quezon province when her family sought permits for a planned fast-food chain business. The high court, in a 16-page ruling in January, released on Friday, reversed the conviction of Jade Karla Tan
